name: Rio Arriba County, NM
findings: Rio Arriba County has 69 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rio Arriba County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Rio Arriba County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Rio Arriba County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: No social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
